t.67-63-0.agn: Highly flammable; its vapour may cause dizziness. Do not use near flames or heat sources.
t.67-63-0.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 603-117-00-0 (CLP00): Flam. Liq. 2, STOT SE 3, Eye Irrit. 2.
t.67-63-0.summary: An alcohol used as a solvent and disinfectant.
t.67-63-0.what: Dissolves grease and dirt and evaporates quickly; at high concentration it kills germs.
t.tem.h.H336: H336 May cause drowsiness or dizziness.
